title: A long-view bishop
objective: Develop a bishop onto a long diagonal.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original synthetic lesson
commentary_source.attribution: Original teaching text and simplified Catalan practice line; not a historical game

steps.explanation: White moved the g-pawn so the bishop has a path into the game.
steps.detail: From g2, the bishop can look across many squares on one diagonal.
steps.coach_prompt: Your g-pawn made a doorway for the bishop.

question.prompt: Where can the bishop go to use that long diagonal?
hints: Move the bishop from f1 to g2.

tree.feedback: Bg2 develops the bishop. It now looks across the board on a long diagonal.
Bh3 develops the bishop, but it misses the space behind your moved g-pawn. Try another home.

question.other_legal_move_text: That move may help later. Return and find a home for the bishop.

takeaway: Moving a pawn can open a useful path for a bishop.
